subject: Your next weekend begins on the night train
preheader: A private cabin, breakfast by the sea and time to take the long way.

content.text: Leave the city at dusk. Wake to the coast. One quiet cabin, a long breakfast and nowhere else you need to be.
Friday evening out. Sunday afternoon home.

attrs.alt: A passenger train curves along a quiet northern coastline toward a pastel harbour town.

content.text: Watch the last city lights slip away, then let the coast come to you. Your weekend begins before you reach the platform.
A private two-berth cabin, fresh linen and a pot of tea. Stow your bag; make yourself at home.
Breakfast arrives with the sea: warm pastries, fruit and coffee, served as the train follows the shore.
Follow the harbour path, find the tiny bookshop and linger over lunch. We leave the plans to you.
From £295 per person, based on two sharing. Return sleeper travel, private cabin and breakfast included.
